fieldDescription: Icons only: icons where only the selected market's button shows its name. Unfold on hover (default): icons expand to show names; the last hovered button stays open. Stretched: keeps the vanilla button count per row. Five per row: fits five named buttons per row. All layouts fill the panel width with Storage at the bottom right. Reopen the screen to apply.
Animated (default): lights move around the selected button in its faction's color. Bright band: a fixed outline. Off: vanilla appearance. Reopen the screen to apply.
Seconds to expand a button in Unfold on hover. Default: 0.1. Set to 0 for instant expansion. Reopen the screen to apply.
Trims square background corners that stick out past the button frame. On by default. Reopen the screen to apply.
